corporate_loan_pct.yr2024: NCC Bank PLC Annual Report 2024, Business Review p.168-169: Corporate Banking Division states/charts 'Corporate Loans & Advances contribute 76% of the total portfolio... in 2024'. retail_pct computed: Retail Banking Division (p.172) discloses BDT 808 crore retail loans, divided by disclosed total loans & advances (Note 9.5) of BDT 24,024.64 crore = 3.36%.

retail_loan_pct.yr2023: Same Retail Asset Growth chart: BDT 796 crore retail loans for 2023, divided by total loans & advances of BDT 22,869.67 crore (Note 9.5 2023 comparative) = 3.48%. No 2023 corporate % was disclosed (76% stated only for 2024, no comparative).
